scope: Read-only ENG3 loader-zero scalar ownership and access review; no acceptance claim.
source_question: Do the assigned loader-zero cells have one direct native access width, a complete zero-tail extent, a writer survey, and an independent HIGHLOW MOV/LEA/PUSH anchor outside pending rows?

method.instruction_source: Read-only ENG3.DLL Capstone instruction index in work/archaeology.sqlite; each examined instruction was byte-checked against ENG3.DLL.
method.access_classification: Enumerated every indexed absolute memory operand at each candidate RVA, recorded its width, read/write use, and exact HIGHLOW displacement fixup. Checked all absolute operands overlapping the proposed scalar extent.
method.anchor_rule: Selected only complete MOV/LEA/PUSH anchors with one HIGHLOW fixup, width within the owner, outside this lane's caller spans, mapped to an ENG3 ledger row not in the pending blocker set.
method.writer_rule: Counted each native memory operand with a Capstone write bit; repeated references to the same instruction are deduplicated by instruction RVA.
method.storage_rule: Verified writable .data zero-tail placement, declared extent, and no loader relocation overlap.
